title: Place the host-core thread away from the core receiving GPU interrupts
inspiration: DeepInfer: zero-overhead CPU/GPU scheduling. Strata: STRATA_HOST_CORE=last (Windows).
conditions: Windows only. Upstream doc reports one machine going from +/-6% run variability to stable and +8%. On hybrid-architecture CPUs also try the pool-affinity variant and measure.
acceptance: standard deviation of decode_tok_s across interleaved runs halved (stability, not mean, is the target).
verdict: NOT YET TESTED - needs a cutover window.
